rows.description: Tu cocina es donde todo sucede. rows.title: Interior Painting | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: A fresh coat of paint changes everything. We prep surfaces the right way, protect your floors and furniture, and leave clean lines every time. We work with all kinds of homes across Miami-Dade. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Interior Painting Done Like a Trade, Not a Side Hustle

rows.title: Pintura Interior | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: Una mano de pintura fresca lo cambia todo. Preparamos las superficies correctamente, protegemos tus pisos y muebles, y dejamos líneas limpias siempre. Trabajamos con todo tipo de hogares en Miami-Dade. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Pintura Interior Hecha Como Oficio, No Trabajo Extra

rows.title: Exterior Painting | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: South Florida weather is rough on paint. We pressure wash, scrape, prime, and apply coatings built to handle the heat, humidity, and rain. Your home's curb appeal matters and we take it seriously. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Exterior Paint Built for South Florida Weather

rows.title: Pintura Exterior | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: El clima del sur de Florida es duro con la pintura. Lavamos a presión, raspamos, aplicamos imprimante y usamos recubrimientos diseñados para el calor, la humedad y la lluvia. La apariencia de tu hogar importa y lo tomamos en serio. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Pintura Exterior Construida para el Clima del Sur de Florida

rows.title: Tile Work | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: We install tile for floors, showers, backsplashes, and more. Porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, large format, whatever the material, we set it level, grouted tight, and built to last in Miami's climate. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Tile Set Level, Grouted Tight, Built to Last

rows.title: Instalación de Pisos | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: Instalamos azulejos para pisos, duchas, salpicaderos y más. Porcelanato, cerámica, piedra natural, formato grande, cualquiera que sea el material, lo colocamos nivelado, con juntas firmes y hecho para durar en el clima de Miami. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Azulejo Nivelado, Lechada Firme, Hecho para Durar

rows.title: Exterior Repairs | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: Cracked stucco, rotting fascia, damaged soffits, water intrusion issues. We fix the exterior problems that South Florida homes deal with constantly. Small repairs now save you from big bills later. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Exterior Repairs That Stop Bigger Bills Later

rows.title: Reparaciones Exteriores | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: Estuco agrietado, fascia podrida, sofitos dañados, problemas de intrusión de agua. Reparamos los problemas exteriores que las casas del sur de Florida enfrentan constantemente. Reparaciones pequeñas ahora te ahorran facturas grandes después. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Reparaciones Exteriores que Detienen Cuentas Mayores

rows.title: Cabinet Refinishing | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: If your kitchen cabinets are solid wood and the layout still works, refinishing gets you what looks like a new kitchen for a fraction of the cost. We strip, sand, prime, and spray with post-catalyzed lacquer or 2K polyurethane. The finish lasts 10 to 15 years and is more durable than what comes from the factory on most new cabinets. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Cabinet Refinishing That Beats Factory Finishes

rows.title: Renovación de Gabinetes | Miami-Dade | Broke & Fixed Home Solutions
rows.description: Si los gabinetes de tu cocina son de madera sólida y la distribución todavía funciona, renovarlos te da lo que parece una cocina nueva por una fracción del costo. Quitamos el acabado, lijamos, aplicamos primer y rociamos con laca post-catalizada o poliuretano 2K. El acabado dura 10 a 15 años y es más duradero que el de fábrica en la mayoría de los gabinetes nuevos. Serving 17 communities across Miami-Dade County. Call 786-363-7039 for a free estimate.
h1: Renovación de Gabinetes Que Supera Acabados de Fábrica
